faces.name: Robber Fly
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever this creature becomes blocked, defending player discards all the cards in their hand, then draws that many cards.

faces.name: Robber of the Rich
faces.oracleText:
Reach, haste
Whenever this creature attacks, if defending player has more cards in hand than you, exile the top card of their library. During any turn you attacked with a Rogue, you may cast that card and you may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell.

faces.name: Robby, Another Dwarf
faces.oracleText: Dwarf creature spells, legendary creature spells, and Equipment spells you cast have squad 2. Tokens created this way aren't legendary. (As an additional cost to cast one of those spells, you may pay {2} any number of times. When that permanent enters, create that many tokens that are copies of it.)
